text: Why do TLS VPNs traverse networks that IPsec cannot?
choices: They run over TCP or UDP 443 and are indistinguishable from HTTPS, so any network permitting web browsing permits them
explanation: IPsec is frequently blocked on hotel and public Wi-Fi. The cost of TLS VPNs in TCP mode is TCP-over-TCP meltdown from interacting retransmission timers, which is why UDP mode is strongly preferable.
